name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Did the systematic config-save preservation audit flagged as overdue after this same bug class kept being found one field at a time across many releases: enumerated every PluginConfiguration/RemoteServer field and checked each against both the GET response (Sanitize/SanitizeServer) and the save-preservation block. Found one real, live instance: EnablePlexStrmExport and PlexStrmExportPath (the .strm export feature added in 0.0.92) were never included in the GET response the config page uses to populate its form - so the checkbox and path field always rendered as off/default on page load regardless of the real saved state, and saving any unrelated setting would silently re-disable strm export and reset its path back to the default the very next time. Both fields are now included in the GET response. Every other field was confirmed already correctly wired (either round-tripped through the main Save form, or preserved via its own dedicated endpoint). 301 tests, all green, run 2x.
